race.description: A Class Earthmoving - Colonel Reeves Stakes (G3)
race.comment: BASSETT HOUND (10) faces his stiffest test yet, though everything underlying his recent wins suggests he's up to this level. Barrier 1 may be a bit sticky, but if the gaps come then he'll be there to explode. Looks a genuine top-liner in the making and he can show what he's capable of today. TALKANCO (6) returned impressively in the Prince Of Wales with a 0.7L victory. Things look a bit sticky from the outside barrier here, but if she gets some luck early in running then she can be right there when the whips are cracking. ROPE THEM IN (1) looks well placed in this event first-up with a nice trial under his belt recently. Has won 5/7 fresh and looks to get plenty of favours from the outset. He can play a major role. IMMORTAL BLISS (3) is racing in good order and can't be left out.
